title: Junior Full Stack Developer Intern
rawText:
TechNova Solutions is looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer Intern to join our product team. You will work alongside senior engineers to build and ship features across our web platform.

What we're looking for:
- Solid understanding of JavaScript fundamentals
- Experience building backend services with Node.js
- Experience building user interfaces with React
- Familiarity with databases, either MongoDB or a relational database like PostgreSQL
- Ability to design and consume REST APIs
- Comfortable with Git and collaborative version control workflows

Nice to have:
- Exposure to TypeScript
- Experience deploying applications to a cloud platform
- Familiarity with writing automated tests

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
